name: Healer starter
desc: Solo rotation: heal under pressure, Energy Flow upkeep for mana and the damage cut, Holy nuke, Heartbeat filler.

name: Horc Evader dodge DPS
desc: Dodge-wall upkeep, Blood Trail stacked to 4, Hunter's Call nuke on full stacks or Weak Spot, Whistle rage on a held wall.

name: King's Echo damage
desc: Full-damage loop: Censure upkeep, Bolt to 8 Residual stacks, CORVAK on a full battery, repeat.

name: King's Echo defense
desc: Defensive loop: shield when exposed, Censure and Overthrown upkeep, Bolt to 8 stacks, CORVAK to reset the shield.

name: Legion Revenant DPS
desc: Buff-first caster rotation: Depravity upkeep, Purgatory/Shade on cooldown to seed Infinita Nox, Anathema nuke, Malevolent Burst battery.

name: LightCaster solo
desc: Spotlight stack upkeep with guaranteed-hit shred, Illuminate buff upkeep and heals, Burned by Light nuke.

name: Mage starter
desc: Elemental combo rotation: Ice Shard sets Frozen Blood, Fireball spends it doubled, Explosion detonates Scorched, shield when hurt.

name: Ninja survival
desc: Vanish upkeep for +100% dodge, Smoke Bomb hit-down on target, Sharpened Edge for crit mana economy, Shuriken filler.

name: Rogue starter
desc: Poison rotation: execute as Viper's Kiss runs out, poison upkeep, Footwork while down, Stiletto for the execute buff.

name: Shadow Dragon Shinobi dodge DPS
desc: Flaming Dragon upkeep, Shadow Kunai stacked to 10, foresight autos, Chi Heal on a hurt bar, Shadow Soul as the emergency.

name: StoneCrusher support DPS
desc: Earth support rotation: shield when exposed, nukes inside Magnitude windows, Stalagmite upkeep, Echoing Earth on cooldown.

name: SwordMaster dodge DPS
desc: Dodge melee rotation: Evasion wall upkeep, Nukiuchi nuke, Sever cripple, Bladefury crit buff.

name: Vampire Lord farming
desc: AoE farming rotation: Deafened uptime, Gouge/Devour on cooldown, Bat burst window.

name: Warrior starter
desc: Single-target rotation: stun nuke on cooldown, Armor Shred upkeep, Prepared crits under guard, guard when hurt.

name: Yami no Ronin dodge DPS
desc: Guide DPS rotation: Tachi/Kettou spam, Maku upkeep for Spinning Dragon, Jigen on the fading Yami. The nuke consumes Flash/Revealed — the dodge reset.
